ask: Selphy: I'm bored, simply bored! I wish to see a {mon}. Do bring one to show me!
thanks: Selphy: Oh! A {mon}! It's even more charming than I dreamed.
Selphy: Here, a little something for your trouble.

lines: A Metal Coat, by the cliff path.
Man: You'd leave a Lemonade for Tectonix? He did love those...
Thank you, truly. Please take this: TM025 Facade. It hits harder when the user is hurt, burned or poisoned.
Man: Scrub, scrub... I keep this stone clean. My Onix, Tectonix, rests here.
On hot days he always wanted a cold Lemonade. I'll never forget that.
Man: Scrub, scrub... Tectonix would be glad you came by.
An Elixir, washed up on the rocks.
A Dragon Scale! Sea Pokémon shed these.
Woman: Eek! A Heracross! May I measure its horn? ...Oh, how splendid!
Woman: Thank you! Please, take this Nest Ball.
Woman: I just adore Heracross! If you ever catch one, please let me measure it!
Woman: That Heracross's horn was magnificent. Come back if you find a bigger one!
A PP Up, by the rocks.
Celio: Bill! You really came. And this must be the friend you told me about.
I'm Celio. I look after the PC network for these islands.
Bill is staying to help me for a while. Here, take this Tri-Pass.
The ferry will carry you between One, Two and Three Island with it.
Celio: Hi! I'm Celio, Bill's friend. I'm building the Network Machine.
It will link Kanto's PCs with faraway regions, so trainers can trade with Johto!
But it needs two special gems, a Ruby and a Sapphire, to power it.
People say Team Rocket has been sneaking around these islands looking for gems...
If you find out anything, please come back and tell me!
done: Celio: Still no Ruby or Sapphire... I heard Team Rocket was seen on Mt. Ember.

fail: Celio: The farther islands are only open to Champions with a National Pokedex.
lines: Celio: You're the Champion, and you have the National Pokedex!
Take this Rainbow Pass. The Seagallop Ferry will take you to Islands 4 through 7.
Maybe out there you'll find where Team Rocket hid the gems!
Celio: The Sapphire! With the Ruby, the Network Machine finally works!
Celio: Kanto is linked to the world. Thank you!
Celio: Oh, and the warehouse files mentioned this old sea chart...
Celio: It shows an island that isn't on any map. Sailors see a pink Pokemon there!
Celio: That's a Ruby! Just what the Network Machine needs!
Celio: Thank you! Now it only lacks a Sapphire. I'll keep looking.

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours across the floor...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

Selphy: But a lady never turns down a battle. Let us see what you can do!

player_won: Selphy: How thrilling! Now, do take me home to my villa at once.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sevii Islands
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Bill is waiting at Cinnabar Island's harbour now that you've beaten Blaine. Ride the Seagallop Ferry with him to One Island and meet his friend Celio, who has a Tri-Pass for you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Rocket on Mt. Ember
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Researchers on Mt. Ember saw Team Rocket digging by the Ruby Path. Find the researchers at the foot of the mountain, then stop the diggers.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lost Lostelle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Lostelle never came home. Her father runs Two Island's Joyful Game Corner: hear him out, then clear the bikers off Three Island and search the Berry Forest past Bond Bridge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Rainbow Pass
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: As Champion with the National Pokedex, ask Celio for the Rainbow Pass to Islands 4-7.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sapphire
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Celio still needs a Sapphire. Lorelei on Four Island knows of trouble in Icefall Cave; the Sapphire lies in the Dotted Hole on Six Island. The Rocket Warehouse on Five Isle Meadow opens with two passwords: one you heard on Mt. Ember, one from whoever takes the Sapphire.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Back to Celio
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You have the Ruby and the Sapphire! Take them to Celio on One Island so he can finish the Network Machine.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Faraway Island
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Celio's old sea map shows an uncharted island. A pink Pokemon lives there...

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Unown of Tanoby
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The seven Tanoby chambers hold Unown of every shape. Catch all 28 to fill the Unown Report!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Flame of Mt. Ember
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Moltres nests at the top of Mt. Ember on One Island. Climb to the summit and face it!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lugia of Navel Rock
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Seagallop sails to Navel Rock now. Deep below the rock, a guardian of the sea is waiting.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ho-Oh of Navel Rock
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: At the very top of Navel Rock, a bird with rainbow wings is waiting.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Birth Island Mystery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A Pokemon from space was seen on Birth Island. Take the Seagallop there and find it!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ruby
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Rocket was after a gem deep in the Ruby Path. Go in by the door the diggers were blocking, down to the room at the bottom.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Celio's Ruby
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You found the Ruby! Take it to Celio at One Island's Network Center.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The National Pokédex
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You're the Champion! Professor Oak in Pallet Town will upgrade your Pokédex to the National Pokédex once you've seen 60 kinds of Pokémon. Celio needs to see it before he'll give you the Rainbow Pass.
